name: Claude Code Integration

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: contains(github.event.issue.body, '@claude') || contains(github.event.pull_request.body, '@claude')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Claude Code Action
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          settings: |
            {
              "auto_review": true,
              "auto_approve": false,
              "auto_merge": false,
              "auto_label": true,
              "auto_assign": true,
              "auto_close": false,
              "auto_rebase": false,
              "auto_squash": false,
              "auto_delete_branch": false,
              "auto_update_branch": false,
              "auto_add_labels": ["claude"],
              "auto_remove_labels": [],
              "auto_assignees": [],
              "auto_reviewers": [],
              "auto_team_reviewers": [],
              "auto_request_changes": false,
              "auto_approve_reviews": false,
              "auto_comment": true,
              "auto_comment_template": "Claude has reviewed this code and provided feedback.",
              "auto_comment_on_pull_request": true,
              "auto_comment_on_issue": true,
              "auto_comment_on_discussion": true,
              "auto_comment_on_commit": true,
              "auto_comment_on_tag": true,
              "auto_comment_on_release": true,
              "auto_comment_on_workflow": true,
              "auto_comment_on_job": true,
              "auto_comment_on_step": true,
              "auto_comment_on_artifact": true,
              "auto_comment_on_environment": true,
              "auto_comment_on_secret": true,
              "auto_comment_on_variable": true,
              "auto_comment_on_repository": true,
              "auto_comment_on_organization": true,
              "auto_comment_on_team": true,
              "auto_comment_on_user": true,
              "auto_comment_on_project": true,
              "auto_comment_on_column": true,
              "auto_comment_on_card": true,
